sql: SELECT s.points, CAST(a.learner_tally*a.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual a JOIN college_score_annual s ON s.college_identifier=a.college_identifier WHERE s.annual=2015 AND a.college_identifier=100

SELECT DISTINCT n.nation_label FROM college_annual a JOIN college c ON c.identifier=a.college_identifier JOIN nation n ON n.identifier=c.nation_identifier WHERE a.annual=2013 AND a.learner_tally*100 > 98*(SELECT AVG(learner_tally) FROM college_annual WHERE annual=2013)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM college_annual a JOIN college_score_annual s ON s.college_identifier=a.college_identifier WHERE a.annual=2011 AND s.points=90

SELECT SUM(a.learner_tally) - SUM(CAST(a.learner_tally*a.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL)/100) FROM college_annual a JOIN college c ON c.identifier=a.college_identifier WHERE c.college_label='Harvard University' AND a.annual BETWEEN 2011 AND 2012

SELECT CAST(a.learner_tally*a.percent_overseas_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual a JOIN college c ON c.identifier=a.college_identifier WHERE c.college_label='Harvard University' AND a.annual=2012

SELECT CAST(a.learner_tally*a.percent_woman_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual a JOIN college c ON c.identifier=a.college_identifier WHERE c.college_label='Stanford University' AND a.annual=2011

SELECT a.learner_tally - CAST(a.learner_tally*a.percent_woman_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual a JOIN college c ON c.identifier=a.college_identifier WHERE c.college_label='Emory University' AND a.annual=2011

SELECT n.nation_label, CAST(a.learner_tally*a.percent_woman_learners AS REAL)/100 FROM college_annual a JOIN college c ON c.identifier=a.college_identifier JOIN nation n ON n.identifier=c.nation_identifier WHERE a.college_identifier=23 AND a.annual=2011

SELECT DISTINCT c.college_label FROM college_score_annual s JOIN college c ON c.identifier=s.college_identifier WHERE s.annual=2015 AND s.points*100 < (SELECT AVG(points) FROM college_score_annual WHERE annual=2015)*28
